questions.template: Ridesharing is {{0}} people who do not {{1}} each other pay separate fares and travel together in the same {{2}}.
questions.prompt: Select the words from the dropdowns to complete the sentence.
questions.explanation: TfL defines ridesharing as separate fares paid by people who do not know each other travelling together in the same vehicle.

questions.template: As a private hire driver, you must {{0}} your PHV licence and {{1}} disc on the vehicle whenever you are working.
questions.prompt: Select the correct words to complete the sentence.
questions.explanation: Drivers must display their TfL PHV identification disc on the vehicle and carry their driver licence at all times when working.

questions.template: If a passenger has an assistance dog, you {{0}} refuse the booking and you {{1}} charge an extra fee for the dog.
questions.prompt: Select the correct words to complete the sentence.
questions.explanation: Under the Equality Act 2010, refusing an assistance dog or charging extra is unlawful discrimination.

questions.template: As a driver, you may have to {{0}} children or adults who are at risk. You may come into {{1}} with passengers that are being trafficked, exploited or abused.
questions.prompt: Select the correct words to complete the sentence.
questions.explanation: Drivers may transport vulnerable passengers and come into contact with people at risk; safeguarding awareness is essential.

questions.template: You must report any incident, accident or {{0}} to TfL within {{1}} hours.
questions.prompt: Select the correct words to complete the sentence.
questions.explanation: TfL requires private hire operators and drivers to report incidents and complaints within 72 hours.

questions.question: What is the maximum number of passengers a private hire vehicle (PHV) can carry?
options: As stated on the vehicle licence
questions.explanation: The maximum number of passengers is set on the vehicle licence and must never be exceeded.

questions.question: A passenger leaves an item in your vehicle. What should you do?
options: Hand it to your operator or the police as soon as possible
Wait for the passenger to call
questions.explanation: Lost property must be handed to the operator or to a police station as soon as reasonably possible.

questions.question: Which of the following is a protected characteristic under the Equality Act 2010?
questions.explanation: Disability is one of nine protected characteristics under the Equality Act 2010.

questions.question: If a passenger asks you to break the speed limit, you should:
options: Politely refuse — you are responsible for safe driving
questions.explanation: You are legally responsible for the safe operation of the vehicle and must obey speed limits at all times.

questions.question: What should you do if your TfL PHV identification disc is lost or stolen?
options: Report it to TfL and apply for a replacement
questions.explanation: A lost or stolen disc must be reported to TfL and a replacement obtained before continuing to work.

questions.question: A wheelchair user books a vehicle. You should:
options: Provide reasonable assistance with boarding and securing the wheelchair
Ask the passenger to fold the wheelchair themselves
questions.explanation: Drivers must provide reasonable assistance to disabled passengers without charging extra.

questions.question: What is the legal blood-alcohol limit for driving in England?
questions.explanation: In England the limit is 80 mg of alcohol per 100 ml of blood, but professional drivers should not drink before working.
